Card Q&A.q: I have 7 cards in my hand. I attack with a Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards, and  from another [When Attacking] effect. I now have 8 cards in my hand. Can I use this card’s inherited effect during the attack to return 1 of my opponent’s Digimon to its owner’s hand?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] If you have 8 or more cards in your hand, return 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon to its owner's hand. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon.
